declare.semantics: Read immutable capability and contract declarations.

plan.semantics: Resolve capabilities and construct a candidate plan; no model calls.

seal.semantics: Verify a human execution-approval receipt and write a seal beside the unchanged plan.

review.semantics: Emit eligible bounded family task requests to capacity routing; human nodes never dispatch.

reconcile.semantics: Validate results and return diagnostic release recommendation, coverage and blockers.

record-decision.semantics: Verify and append an externally authenticated human decision; cannot manufacture approval.

inspect.semantics: Read state, result refs, pending human work and ledger reconciliation.

conform.semantics: Evaluate workbench interface contract and named critical cases; editorial efficacy remains separate.

stdout: Exactly one UTF-8 JSON object plus newline per verb, including refusal. Logs go to redacted stderr; no progress or manuscript text on stdout.

exit_codes.0: Operation evaluated successfully; inspect editorial status, which may be hold or awaiting_human.
exit_codes.1: Technical failure without a valid completed evaluation; no release effect.
exit_codes.2: Invalid request, denied authority/route, critical admission failure, or prohibited effect; canonical refusal document.

rules.text: Original bytes are read-only; derivatives live outside source and repository roots.
Recheck source digests before extraction, every model stage, and packet assembly; bind processing to the verified bytes.
Plan, family map, stage profile, rules, policies, routes, formats, skill pins and source bundle are content-addressed; approvals bind the exact plan digest.
Capability routing uses the canonical map; capacity admission is performed by the Loading Bay.
Human stages have lane human and no model dispatch object. Machine verbs cannot accept edits, adjudicate authorship, or approve a release package.
No publication or external-distribution operation exists in this interface.
Draft packages may produce labeled diagnostic results; draft is never implied acceptance or promotion.
Missing CE remains absent; no substitution by SGI or TE. Required absence holds the relevant release claim.
Unknown evidence is dark coverage, never pass, fail, zero, or misconduct. Claims need capture references; disagreements and ties survive.
Critical conformance failure blocks admission or release regardless of scores. Undeclared family critical coverage prevents production clearance.
Receipts require authenticated external human authority verification, exact object binding, expiry and scope checks; an actor_type field alone is insufficient.
A new source, rule, map, schema, route, tool/model revision, baseline, proof, or approval invalidates affected results and opens a successor plan.
Accepted proof correction is not closed until incorporation and dependent reproof evidence exist.
Retain the RCI-before-SEI edge, commit-plus-tree-hash locks, source gates, author packets and independent human acceptance.
No manuscript, author metadata, credentials or runtime output is written to a repository. Restricted input is refused pending separate handling policy.
Kata is the execution ledger; receipt storage is subordinate evidence. Linear commitments and Notion knowledge are separate projections.
Runtime dispatch requires immutable accepted-for-routing Dock ancestry, task envelope, G0/G1 authority, route approval and approved pins; a design candidate grants none.
No package promotion, new execution pin, G3 external effect or G5/G6 change is inferred from a successful review or test.

state_layout.root: required operator-supplied absolute private directory outside every repository and source root

ledgers.writer: single writer per run; exclusive append lock, flush+fsync before acknowledgment
ledgers.replay: same event_id is idempotent; conflicting duplicate or truncated chain blocks further dispatch
ledgers.system_of_record: Kata; local events are evidence/outbox only; failed acknowledgment is projection_pending, not execution success

non_claims: No runtime implemented by this design packet
No family package promoted or repinned
No MWM chapter or author material processed
No editorial accuracy or production-readiness certification
No external distribution or publication authority

extensions_requiring_review: human-only node sum type and verified receipts

house_conformance.recommendation: Keep one house v1; propose a named editorial extension and shared human-node/receipt semantics. Do not mint v2 before comparing the actual upstream schema.
